Karl Ploberger erkundet das Naturparadies Dominica, der Geheimtipp unter den Inseln in der Karibik. Umrahmt von Sonne, Strand und Meer leben die Menschen dort die karibische Lebensfreude. Er entdeckt viele tropische Gartenparadiese.

Die Insel Dominica gilt als wahrer Geheimtipp unter den zahlreichen Inseln in der Karibik. Hier finden sich viele Spuren vulkanischer Aktivitäten sowie grüne Tropennatur und malerische Bergkulissen. Sonne, Strand und Meer fehlen ebenfalls nicht.

pr.t: Brahmaputra - Der große Fluss vom Himalaya
pr.d: Zwischen Quelle und Schlucht und entlang des Hauptkamms des Himalaya erschließt sich die wohl dynamischste Landschaft der Erde. Die tiefsten und längsten Schluchten der Welt verbinden die Welten, die das höchste Gebirge der Erde trennt.

pr.t: Brahmaputra - Der große Fluss vom Himalaya
pr.d: Der Oberlauf des Brahmaputra, der indische Yarlung Tsangpo fließt von seinem Ursprung in 5.200 Meter Höhe 1.700 Kilometer westwärts, bis der Namjagbarwa ihn in eine riesige Schleife und dann in die tiefste und längste Schlucht der Welt zwingt.

pr.t: Brahmaputra - Der große Fluss vom Himalaya
pr.d: Der Brahmaputra legt von seiner Quelle am Dach der Welt bis zur Mündung im Indischen Ozean rund 3.100 Kilometer zurück. Er ernährt Millionen von Menschen in China, Indien und Bangladesch und erschafft riesige Gebiete voll faszinierender Biodiversität. Brahmaputra, Sohn des Schöpfers, ist nur einer seiner vielen Namen. Im Oberlauf, im Tibetischen Hochland, heißt er Yarlung Tsangpo. Er erzählt die turbulente Geschichte eines gigantischen Gebirges und eines ebenso stattlichen Flusses.

Bei Frühlingseinbruch kommt die atemberaubendste Verwandlung der Natur in Gange: Wasser, Licht und Wärme kehren zurück. Dies mag zwar magisch wirken, aber für die Tiere, aus ihrem Winterschlaf erwacht, beginnt ein heftiger Konkurrenzkampf.

Alaska - seine Position am nördlichen Polarkreis bedeutet, dass die Winter bitterlich kalt sein können, während im Sommer die Größe und die Form des Landes sogar Hitzewellen bringen. Die wenigen kurzen Wochen des Sommers in Alaska müssen der reichhaltigen Wildnis Kraft für das ganze Jahr geben. Der Sommer ist eine wahnsinnige Zeit. Während sich wunderschöne Reichtümer zu erkennen geben, gibt es für sie zu wenig Zeit, ihr Überleben zu meistern.

In keinem anderen Land sind die Saisonunterschiede so groß wie hier. Vor allem der Winter erfordert besondere Vorbereitung. Riesige Gebirge, das Land umschließende Ozeane und die nördliche Lage erwecken einen der härtesten Winter der Erde. Vorbereitung ist alles, wenn sich die kalte Jahreszeit ankündigt - das Land friert ein, Stürme wüten, und eine endlose Dunkelheit umfasst das Land.

34-year-old Sunny is rushed to Resus with multiple stab wounds to his chest and back. Doctors are concerned about why 87-year-old Eunice is coughing up blood. And 15-year-old Tyler has injured his foot playing football.

When a man lashes out at two female paramedics, they're forced to call for help. A man who has severe abdominal pains is reluctant to go to hospital. And a woman has fallen at home, cutting her knee to the bone.

pr.t: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
pr.d: At The Old Coffee Pot in New Orleans, a century-old bistro in the middle of the busy French Quarter, Gordon has 24 hours to create a new dining room, set up a grab-and-go coffee station and whip up an exciting new menu.
Jimmy and Ellie have to face their feelings while they work together on night shift. Curtis confronts Gloria over her controversial decision-making, but Gloria refuses to listen to him.

The interns, with Josh as a surprise inclusion, face their biggest challenge when they have to take their mid-terms in the middle of a hospital evacuation. Gloria gets a clear message from the Medical Board.
In Cambridgeshire, big kids Wizz and Luke throw a children's party-themed night, Diana and Mark do fine dining, and Ed and Steve serve an enormous trifle.

While the Keane family feud, Caleb's health takes a turn for the worse, and Frankie's determination to help him causes accusations to fly. Abigail pushes Dee Dee to audition for the lead role in the school play. And a couple plan their wedding.

Sam hosts Frasier's bachelor party at Cheers, but the party takes a depressing turn when Frasier recognises the stripper as one of his patients. Separately, Rebecca hosts a bachelorette party for Lilith, which also goes badly wrong.
While Norm paints Evan's house, Rebecca seizes the opportunity to sneak a look at his bedroom. However, this backfires on Rebecca as she becomes trapped when Norm comes home unexpectedly.
Doug and Carrie's dinner party for Ray and Debra Barone goes far from well. Why oh why did Doug decide to go into the attic?
Doug start to strut his stuff when he thinks a pretty waitress likes him. Carrie is less than impressed.
It's Thanksgiving and Doug invites Spencer over to his house to try and get away from Carrie's irritating friends. Will his plan work?
Ray confesses to Debra that her cuddly sleeping position is preventing him from getting his rest; guest Charles Durning.
Debra and Ray are trying too hard to have a good time while on a romantic weekend in Vermont. Meanwhile, Marie spies on Robert, who is left to babysit the kids.
When Debra gets a job, Ray isn't happy to have to help with the housework and Marie worries about the effect it will have on the family, but Debra's career could be over before it's begun.
Frasier tries to plan Donny's stag party and ends up handcuffed to a stripper, embarrassing himself in front of Regan. Meanwhile, Niles discovers that Maris has ballooned to obesity pining for him.
Frasier is initially flattered to be featured as a caricature at a restaurant, until he sees the finished product.
Daphne needs an anger management class after her brother comes to town and wreaks havoc in the Crane home.
Frasier gives both Daphne and Niles romantic advice, and Daphne's demanding mother and deadbeat brother complicate her wedding.

pr.d: Gordon visits Los Toros, a family-run Mexican restaurant in Chatsworth, California, to restyle the premises with a warm, modern colour scheme and introduce a new menu.
Channel 4's midday news summary.

In the Scottish Borders, Rosi and Antony bring their farmhouse ceiling down. Catherine and Alan create an elegant sitting room in their Victorian hall in Shropshire. And in Orpington, Naomi and Shemar get started on the reno of their 1930s semi.

Colin Murray, Rachel Riley and Susie Dent host, with Konnie Huq in Dictionary Corner, as contestants race against the clock to pit their wits against vowels, consonants and numbers.

On the second night in north Wales, law student Jake showcases his favourite vegetable, the mighty Welsh leek. But with some grumbling guests, can he maintain diplomacy around the table?

Father and son Sam and Dillon want a holiday home in the Abruzzo region of Italy. Lee Juggurnauth shows them what their maximum budget of £100k can get them, from a rustic apartment to a place with personality and a characterful courtyard.
Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

Helen faces an impossible choice as Steve's façade collapses in a terrifying, violent unravelling, and she begins to plot her escape.

Monica and Chandler prepare for their wedding. Meanwhile, Joey is starring in a movie with a prestigious actor with a spitting problem.
Joey encounters problems trying to get off the movie set to officiate the wedding when the star turns up drunk.

The girls speculate as to who's the father of Rachel's baby, the guys scramble after Chandler loses the film from his wedding, and Monica wants to open the wedding gifts.
Everybody seems to know who the father of Rachel's baby is except the man himself. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Joey lie about a gas leak to get into Monica and Chandler's apartment.

Feeling guilty for denying Chandler a bachelor party, Monica hires a stripper to perform for him, without learning that she's a prostitute. Elsewhere, Rachel's father learns about her pregnancy and plans to give Ross a piece of his mind.

Meanwhile, Chandler and Phoebe pretend to be mesmerised by American football in order to avoid helping Monica in the kitchen, and Joey vows to devour the entire turkey single-handedly.

Bluey und Bingo spielen "Das Schweigespiel" und wollen Dad sagen, welches Spielzeug er für sie kaufen soll. Am Ende seiner Kräfte spannt Dad den neuen Verkäufer Alfie in das Spiel ein, um die Pantomime zu interpretieren.

Als Mama und Papa eine Meinungsverschiedenheit haben, zwingt Bluey Papa, einen Liebesbrief an Mama zu schreiben, um sich zu versöhnen. Bluey muss sich einen Weg einfallen lassen, den Brief ohne Probleme an Mama zu überbringen.

Im Park trifft Bluey auf eine neue Kameradin namens Winnie. Als Bluey sie jedoch mit ihrem Vater zum Frühstück einladen möchte, stellt sie fest, dass Erwachsene etwas länger brauchen, bis sie neue Freunde gefunden haben.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Die Superschurken sind fest entschlossen, alles zu zerstören, was mit Liebe zu tun hat.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Die Schüler Marinette und Adrien erhalten die Fähigkeit, sich in die Superhelden Ladybug und Cat Noir zu verwandeln und können dadurch das Glück und das Pech manipulieren. Sie wollen dem Bösewicht Hawk Moth das Handwerk legen.

Cricket und seine Familie ziehen vom Land in die Großstadt, was zuerst einen großen Kulturschock auslöst. Doch Cricket ist optimistisch und naiv, was ihn schnell neue Freunde finden lässt. Zusammen erleben sie viele Abenteuer in der großen Stadt.
Nachdem er wegen seines Händedrucks verspottet wurde, trainiert Cricket für ein Händedruckduell.

Jay belauscht Gloria, wie sie bei einem Telefonat vom Hintern versohlen spricht. Infolgedessen denkt er, dass sie dem gemeinsamen Liebesleben mehr Würze verleihen möchte. Zum Anlass von Mitchs neuem Job organisieren er und Cam eine große Feier.

Als die Familie zu einer Weinprobe hinausfährt, kommt sie im Landhaus von Haleys Boss unter. Dort müssen sie eine wichtige Regel beachten: Das Diadem muss unberührt bleiben. Unterdessen werden Gloria und Mitch von Oprah zu einer Feier eingeladen.

Bruce Nolan ist ein Boulevardfernsehreporter in Buffalo, New York, der mit fast allem in seinem Leben unzufrieden ist, trotz seiner Popularität und der Liebe seiner Freundin Grace. Am Ende des schlimmsten Tages in seinem Leben ist er wütend und lästert gegen Gott, und Gott reagiert. Er erscheint in menschlicher Form, stattet Bruce mit all seinen göttlichen Kräften aus, und fordert ihn auf, seinen Job zu übernehmen, um zu sehen, ob er ihn besser machen kann.

In einem Club verliebt sich J.D. in die attraktive Kylie. Zufällig ist diese gerade auf der Suche nach einem Arzt. Allerdings braucht nicht sie einen Arzt, sondern ihr Freund James. Bei der Untersuchung stellt J.D. bei James einen Tripper fest.

J.D.s neue Freundin Kylie kommt ihn bei der Arbeit besuchen und er will sie beeindrucken. Das verleitet ihn, zu erwähnen, dass ein Patient, der vor kurzem in Hongkong war, SARS haben könnte. Das führt dazu, dass die gesamte Klinik in Quarantäne muss.

Der Autor von J.D.s Lieblingssitcom wird ins Sacred Heart eingeliefert. Leider findet J.D. heraus, dass der Mann an Lungenkrebs leidet. J.D. flüchtet sich in einen Tagtraum, in dem der Alltag eine alberne Sitcom ist und alle ihr Happy End finden.

Cece und Coach gehen miteinander aus, was Schmidt sehr missfällt. Jess versucht, Schmidt über Cece hinwegzuhelfen. Winston sucht derweil gemeinsam mit Nick den entwischten Ferguson und lernt dabei eine Frau kennen.

Weil Coach ihm vorwirft, dass er in der Beziehung mit Jess seine Männlichkeit verliert, beschließt Nick, zu Thanksgiving campen zu gehen. Da Jess aber möchte, dass alle an dem Feiertag zusammen essen, kommt die ganze WG inklusive Cece mit zum Campen. Doch das Essen gestaltet sich schwieriger als gedacht, weil Nick nichts mitgebracht hat, sondern darauf besteht, dass sie alles selbst jagen und sammeln.

Jess erhält ein neues Jobangebot und muss sich in nur 20 Minuten entscheiden, ob sie ihre Arbeit als Lehrerin an den Nagel hängt oder nicht. Das bringt ihre Freunde dazu, selbst darüber nachzudenken, wie sie zu ihren jeweiligen Jobs gekommen sind.

Das Mädchen Verena ist in einfachen Verhältnissen aufgewachsen und wurde durch die Heirat mit Anatol Manesse-Manconi zur Gräfin. Doch der Graf ist herzlos und unfähig zur Liebe. Er macht Verena zu seinem Lustobjekt, auch vor seinen Gästen. Eine Reihe von seltsamen Männern, die die sieben Todsünden verkörpern, gaffen auf Verena, die als Göttin der Triebe präsentiert wird. Dann wird der Mechaniker Toni ermordet.

Pauli genießt seine Auszeit vom Internat in der Familie seiner Villa, wo sich die ganze Verwandtschaft trifft und sich der körperlichen Lust hingibt. Pauli möchte mit den Erwachsenen mithalten können und trifft dabei auf die unwiderstehliche Andrea, deren Anblick seine Fantasie beflügelt. Doch der Weg bis zur Erfüllung dieser lustvollen Träumereien ist von Wirrungen, Kurven und hohen Schwellen gezeichnet.

pr.t: Schulmädchen-Report 4: Was Eltern oft verzweifeln lässt
pr.d: Ob es um das Aufbessern der Noten, den Umgang mit lästigen Klassenkameraden oder die erste Beziehung geht - frühreife Schülerinnen finden für jedes Problem eine passende Lösung. Und die erfordert fast immer, dass sie die Hüllen fallen lassen. Angelika gibt ihren Freund als Schularzt aus, um mit ihm zusammen sein zu können. Vier Mädchen beglücken einen jungen Mann und ein Geschwisterpaar begeht Inzest, während ein paar 17-Jährige ein Schülerinnenbordell betreiben.

In Wien soll Klaus Nashörner untersuchen, doch mit einem Affen, der dem Alkohol verfallen ist, und anderen tierischen Problemfällen hat Klaus genug zu tun. While Ellie and Pascoe are on their honeymoon, Dalziel goes on a touring holiday in East Anglia and finds himself drawn into fraud, murder and family conspiracy at a country house.
After Ray Tiernan, Harry's ex and Charlie's mentor, is murdered while running a secret investigation, Harry and Fergus will stop at nothing to unmask the killer.

Having broken into her home, DC Spears resolves to watch DS Cork's every move. Elsewhere, PC Klein finds himself being blackmailed into providing an alibi.
Daniel gets involved when a dispute between neighbours takes a dramatic turn, and a chance encounter with Scott and Cherry puts Rob in an awkward situation.
Cherry's life is torn apart after she receives devastating news.
A face from Abra's past upsets all his plans and shows up his dishonesty to heavy-drinking Kyla. Jac taunts Joseph by wearing his grandmother's ring.
Cal and Ethan work together to solve a patient's medical mystery, Rita helps a patient come to terms with a secret and Connie and Tess discuss the open position for a senior staff nurse.
Having broken into her home, DC Spears resolves to watch DS Cork's every move. Elsewhere, PC Klein finds himself being blackmailed into providing an alibi.
Christian continues to put his trust in Syed, but a jealous Ben intervenes. Meanwhile, Janine excitedly unveils her new business, and Pat finds herself softening towards Norman.
Zainab and Yusef return from Pakistan to a new arrival. Michael helps Janine throw a party to launch Butcher's Joints, and a devastated Norman is forced to leave the Square.
Max and new neighbour Clive Gibbons have a row over Clive and his gorillagram costume. Zoe may stay in Erinsborough, while Madge Mitchell and Eileen Clarke get chatting about Daphne and Des.
Clive plays loud music, annoying Max, but he gets revenge by playing a late-night prank. Jim Robinson builds a new jack for his car, and wants to demonstrate it to his business partner.

An energy tycoon hires Frank and Lu to keep an eye on his wayward eldest daughter and ensure that the wedding of his youngest daughter goes off without a hitch, but things are about to get a lot worse.
Father Brown encounters a voodoo priest who is intent on winning back the woman he loves, no matter the cost.
Terry and June get off to a bad start with their new neighbours in a dispute over a lawnmower. Soon things escalate, as they always do when Terry gets a bee in his bonnet over something.
The aged and absent-minded Doggy is quite disappointed that his stag night isn't as exciting as his first. Clegg, Truly, Alvin and Entwistle soon rectify that problem.

A perfectly innocent woodland becomes a legendary site of ghostly activity thanks to an inventive rumour spread by Alvin, Truly and Clegg. However, their attempts to scare Howard grow increasingly out of hand.
Howard gets a great deal when he buys a used car, but the attention he gets from a burly local is rather more than he bargained for.
A naked, glowing man with no memory leads Anna and Frederick to unravel a decades-old mystery.
Lady Felicia asks Father Brown to help prove a convicted serial killer didn't murder her beloved goddaughter.

The discovery of an armoured security van involved in the disappearance of one person and the unsolved murder of another provides the impetus for the team to look into the case again. The van is at the bottom of a lake and Pullman decides to dive and investigate. She survives, but a key witness does not and the team realise that the murderer is close at hand.
As Boyd and the team delve into Harry Newman's past, they uncover a connection to the infamous trial and execution of a well-known London gangster.

It's the season finale and the tension is at its peak! Chris and Kerri must choose who has captured their hearts. Will it be one of their daters, or could it be each other? Their decisions shock everyone as their final choices are revealed.
In the series finale, Chris and Kerri each go on three dates with matches they've already dated on the island, before a jaw-dropping final elimination ends in joy and heartbreak.
Abbie and Charlie are missing one thing from their perfect marriage: a woman to turn them from a couple into a throuple. And glamour puss Chrissie is looking for husband number four.

Beks learns the truth from Freddy about the lovebite on his neck. Will Jazz's moment of comfort with Inga affect her relationship with Eve? And after hearing that Jules' mother has been hinting at grandchildren, Tristan asks James Taylor for advice.

Captain Jason introduces anonymous guest feedback cards and the crew celebrates a record-breaking tip. During a crew night out, personal tensions bubble to the surface when Alesia's romantic rejection sparks fallout and a game turns explosive.
Janine spearheads a pilot programme that brings a librarian to Abbott; Melissa and Jacob deal with some big changes at home.
Hoping to enjoy a genuine spring break experience, Erica and Barry pay a visit to Pops in Florida, but the jaunt isn't what they expected.
In hopes of the perfect white Christmas she never had in Columbia, Gloria rents a cabin in the mountains for the whole family, including Andy, to celebrate the Christmas holiday.

Gordon is in Atlanta, Georgia, to visit Michon's, a family-run smokehouse restaurant with a future that's about to go up in smoke because of mismanagement and lazy cooking. Michon's owner, Al Wilson, had always hoped that one day he would pass his beloved restaurant over to his daughter, Natalie. But when he suffered a collapsed lung, the handover came about much earlier than expected.
High-flying groom Kev and his ex-paratrooper best man Sam sat down with bride Trish and her best mate Charlene to remember one of the most turbulent weddings in 'Don't Tell the Bride' history.
Jonah's claims shake his family. Dee Dee sabotages her audition. And it's full steam ahead for one couple as they plan their wedding.
Tony snaps at Dee Dee, who continues to act up, and Abigail rushes out of a staff meeting after a worrying call. Elsewhere, a resident refuses to keep more secrets.
A short clip from Rude Tube's incredibly naughty little sister Rude-ish Tube, featuring food and animals.
A short, cheeky clip featuring animals and food, from the always hilarious Tube that is Rude.
In Bournemouth, animal-lover Sarah-Jane is disturbed by talk of animal butchery and pescatarian Zoe is accidentally served meat as three couples compete to host the best dinner party.

Gordon Ramsay travels to Fremont, California, to try to save a restaurant that is tearing the owners' marriage apart. Saki Kavouniaris took over the failing Spin-a-Yarn restaurant in 1995 and began to turn it into a success. He fell in love with a waitress, but the restaurant and the marriage are now failing.

Gordon visits Italian bistro Charlie's in La Verne, Southern California, which was bought in 2010 by Tatiana Leiva, her mother and her sister. Tatiana didn't actually put any money into the purchase herself, but her hard-working mother and sister did because they felt they were helping to fulfil Tatiana's dream. They even put up their houses as collateral! Unfortunately, soon Charlie's was in trouble.
Sibling rivalries; the ongoing battle of humans vs. rodents; a child gets hold of a shaver and decides to give themselves a quick trim.
Will sneaks out with Philip's mother to a rap concert. Despite his anger, Philip realises he must worry less about his mother's health and allow her to live life as she wants.
Jazz fixes Will up with his beautiful sister Janet, who turns out to be extremely bossy.
Marge hires a beautiful piano instructor to help Bart explore his creative side; Homer loses his last two hairs.
Friendships are tested when Carl skips town with $200,000, winnings from a lottery ticket he bought with Homer, Moe and Lenny.
When Marge mistakenly signs up for a website for married people looking for extramarital relationships, a charming man starts pursuing her.

The family fight when a game of Monopoly goes wrong, and Maggie has to call the police. They are arrested, the story makes the papers, and Homer and Flanders' Vegas wives turn up intent on replacing Marge and Maude.
Beverly takes up dancing with her friends but is dejected when her family is unimpressed by her intention to perform in a recital.
Barry gets the chance to throw the first pitch at a Phillies baseball game. Erica makes an important decision about her future.
Claire's new position means Phil feels like a housewife. Gloria's provocative sauce ad gets Jay jealous. Mitch and Cam rent the flat above their own, but end up spying on their guests.
A huge thunderstorm brings city-wide power outages, and the whole family congregates at Jay and Gloria's to use their generator.
Claire has somehow turned into super mum. She's running Jay's closet business and still has time for all her duties at home.
Phil gets an attractive new client and tries to keep her a secret from Claire. Meanwhile, Claire gets attention from her hot new yoga teacher.
A hypnotist reawakens repressed memories from Homer's childhood, but what was the event that scared him so badly when he was 12?

Two single people arrive in Bora Bora, where they will spend 12 weeks without distractions, looking for love.
Natalie and David spend 12 weeks in Bora Bora on a unique dating experience, looking for love in the nuddy. David gets hot under the collar (even though he's not wearing one).

Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching: 'Planet Earth III', 'Mamma Mia! I Have a Dream', 'Surviving Paradise', 'Uncanny', 'Celebrity Race Across the World', 'Crack Addicts' and BBC News (Sir Bobby Charlton).

It's the season finale and the tension is at its peak! Chris and Kerri must choose who has captured their hearts. Will it be one of their daters, or could it be each other? Their decisions shock everyone as their final choices are revealed.
In the series finale, Chris and Kerri each go on three dates with matches they've already dated on the island, before a jaw-dropping final elimination ends in joy and heartbreak.
Abbie and Charlie are missing one thing from their perfect marriage: a woman to turn them from a couple into a throuple. And glamour puss Chrissie is looking for husband number four.

Beks learns the truth from Freddy about the lovebite on his neck. Will Jazz's moment of comfort with Inga affect her relationship with Eve? And after hearing that Jules' mother has been hinting at grandchildren, Tristan asks James Taylor for advice.

Captain Jason introduces anonymous guest feedback cards and the crew celebrates a record-breaking tip. During a crew night out, personal tensions bubble to the surface when Alesia's romantic rejection sparks fallout and a game turns explosive.
Janine spearheads a pilot programme that brings a librarian to Abbott; Melissa and Jacob deal with some big changes at home.
Hoping to enjoy a genuine spring break experience, Erica and Barry pay a visit to Pops in Florida, but the jaunt isn't what they expected.
In hopes of the perfect white Christmas she never had in Columbia, Gloria rents a cabin in the mountains for the whole family, including Andy, to celebrate the Christmas holiday.

Gordon is in Atlanta, Georgia, to visit Michon's, a family-run smokehouse restaurant with a future that's about to go up in smoke because of mismanagement and lazy cooking. Michon's owner, Al Wilson, had always hoped that one day he would pass his beloved restaurant over to his daughter, Natalie. But when he suffered a collapsed lung, the handover came about much earlier than expected.
High-flying groom Kev and his ex-paratrooper best man Sam sat down with bride Trish and her best mate Charlene to remember one of the most turbulent weddings in 'Don't Tell the Bride' history.
Jonah's claims shake his family. Dee Dee sabotages her audition. And it's full steam ahead for one couple as they plan their wedding.
Tony snaps at Dee Dee, who continues to act up, and Abigail rushes out of a staff meeting after a worrying call. Elsewhere, a resident refuses to keep more secrets.
A short clip from Rude Tube's incredibly naughty little sister Rude-ish Tube, featuring food and animals.
A short, cheeky clip featuring animals and food, from the always hilarious Tube that is Rude.
In Bournemouth, animal-lover Sarah-Jane is disturbed by talk of animal butchery and pescatarian Zoe is accidentally served meat as three couples compete to host the best dinner party.

Gordon Ramsay travels to Fremont, California, to try to save a restaurant that is tearing the owners' marriage apart. Saki Kavouniaris took over the failing Spin-a-Yarn restaurant in 1995 and began to turn it into a success. He fell in love with a waitress, but the restaurant and the marriage are now failing.

Gordon visits Italian bistro Charlie's in La Verne, Southern California, which was bought in 2010 by Tatiana Leiva, her mother and her sister. Tatiana didn't actually put any money into the purchase herself, but her hard-working mother and sister did because they felt they were helping to fulfil Tatiana's dream. They even put up their houses as collateral! Unfortunately, soon Charlie's was in trouble.
Sibling rivalries; the ongoing battle of humans vs. rodents; a child gets hold of a shaver and decides to give themselves a quick trim.
Will sneaks out with Philip's mother to a rap concert. Despite his anger, Philip realises he must worry less about his mother's health and allow her to live life as she wants.
Jazz fixes Will up with his beautiful sister Janet, who turns out to be extremely bossy.
Marge hires a beautiful piano instructor to help Bart explore his creative side; Homer loses his last two hairs.
Friendships are tested when Carl skips town with $200,000, winnings from a lottery ticket he bought with Homer, Moe and Lenny.
When Marge mistakenly signs up for a website for married people looking for extramarital relationships, a charming man starts pursuing her.

The family fight when a game of Monopoly goes wrong, and Maggie has to call the police. They are arrested, the story makes the papers, and Homer and Flanders' Vegas wives turn up intent on replacing Marge and Maude.
Beverly takes up dancing with her friends but is dejected when her family is unimpressed by her intention to perform in a recital.
Barry gets the chance to throw the first pitch at a Phillies baseball game. Erica makes an important decision about her future.
Claire's new position means Phil feels like a housewife. Gloria's provocative sauce ad gets Jay jealous. Mitch and Cam rent the flat above their own, but end up spying on their guests.
A huge thunderstorm brings city-wide power outages, and the whole family congregates at Jay and Gloria's to use their generator.
Claire has somehow turned into super mum. She's running Jay's closet business and still has time for all her duties at home.
Phil gets an attractive new client and tries to keep her a secret from Claire. Meanwhile, Claire gets attention from her hot new yoga teacher.
A hypnotist reawakens repressed memories from Homer's childhood, but what was the event that scared him so badly when he was 12?
The Blunder Years: A hypnotist reawakens repressed memories from Homer's childhood. But what was the event that scared him so badly when he was 12? Guest starring Paul Newman.
Bart and Homer are tethered together by a strict judge after Bart and Milhouse are accused of stealing Chief Wiggum's police car.
The Parent Rap: Bart and Homer are tethered together by a strict judge after Bart and Milhouse are accused of stealing Chief Wiggum's police car.
In a nod to the hit cable series Homeland, Lisa suspects Homer may have been turned when he returns a changed man from a nuclear power plant operating convention.
Homerland: When Homer returns from a nuclear power convention a changed man, Lisa suspects that he might have been brainwashed and hires an FBI agent to investigate.
The scariest Halloween show yet, featuring an opening by Guillermo del Toro and including monsters and classic characters from horror films throughout history.
Treehouse of Horror XXIV: In three spine-tingling stories, Homer rhymes in a Dr Seuss-style tale, Bart is beheaded in a kite-flying prang, and a travelling circus visits town.
Alarm bells ring when Sienna realises that Dee Dee spent the night at Abigail's. Ste arranges to meet Imran. And Jack and Pearl plan their big day.

Will's glaring absenteeism at school and around the house makes it hard to keep his new job a secret.
Will and Carlton become rivals when they take college-entrance exams.
PSAT Pstory: When Will outscores Carlton in an exam, Carlton is so desperate to prove his superiority that he gets caught cheating in a history test.

Steven Newman, CEO of Loehmann's department stores, goes undercover posing as an aspiring entrepreneur in a reality TV contest who is trying to win money to start up his own firm.

Jane Grote Abell, chairwoman of Donatos Pizza and daughter of the company's founder, goes undercover posing as a contestant on a reality TV show who is trying to win money to open up her own restaurant.
Lara and Greg serve a travel-inspired menu. Andrew and Liz attempt a dress rehearsal for their wedding breakfast. And Jenna and Mitch prove that looks can be deceptive.
In Lincolnshire, former soldier Scott is under his partner Clare's command, Su and Dylan serve up a pagan ritual and a Gary Barlow tribute, and Adele and Dave recreate an officers' mess.

In the year that same-sex marriage became legal in England, former drama student Jack from Essex is hoping to impress his husband-to-be James by putting on the performance of a lifetime, as well as a wedding.

In this Christmas Special, a loving couple from Rotherham switch roles as the groom takes on all wedding planning responsibility. Steve gets 12,000 pounds and three weeks to plan a wedding with an icy twist.

pr.d: Steve from Rotherham plans a wedding with an icy twist for his bride Emma, who wants an impressive, upmarket affair. But will his big ideas leave him snowed under?
In Stanton, California, Dave learns that making a profit is sometimes like pulling teeth. Mary grinds to get into the black, and Ivy's locker ends up sucking and blowing.
Shana and Edwina bring their `Golden Girls' chic to Riverside, California, but end up phoning it in. A messy unit catches Dave's attention, and Rene switches from buying to selling.

Joe DiDomizio is the president and CEO of Hudson Group, a travel retailer that operates newsstands, bookshops, cafés and speciality stores in 70 airports and other transportation terminals throughout North America.
Utah Jazz CEO Greg Miller's team spirit is tested when he is asked to be a human basketball hoop while he is undercover.
Nine finalists compete for the $100,000 prize; basketball blunders; trick shots; curious cats.
Mary needs help managing a tiny car park in Van Nuys, California, Ivy goes on the prowl for a bike and Justin tries to show the rest of the buyers how to make the most out of a unit.
Brandi and Jarrod bring an old friend along to do some heavy lifting. Ivy finds his fun in the little things and Mary discovers where her bread is really buttered.
A new romance blossoms on a crew night out - and an old friendship falls apart. Tzarina frustrates Alesia. And Jason pushes Lara out of her comfort zone.
Chef Ramsay revisits La Frite, Kingston Cafe, Capri and Spanish Pavilion to see if the owners succeeded in following his advice.

Gordon heads to Boston for the first of two visits to La Galleria 33, an Italian restaurant opened in 2006 by raucous sisters Rita and Lisa. The two siblings grew up working at their father's successful restaurant nearby, but when they opened their own establishment, the customers didn't materialise. The sisters blame everything from the weather to the tablecloths for their failures.

Three top chefs from Scotland are out to impress this week's veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion. Adam Handling has already won a number of industry awards and is full of confidence. His starter sets out to take the diner on a tour of the UK's best producers. He's up against Michael Bremner, who is hoping to impress with contemporary ingredients including Birch sap and Douglas fir oil. Ally McGrath is celebrating his nation's finest produce and making his very own version of haggis.
Three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach. Also, the highly competitive Adam Handling has been showcasing the finest produce grown and caught in and around the UK in his menu. Once again Michael Bremner is out to show how inventive he can be.

One chef will go home, and today the veteran judge finds himself with a difficult decision to make. Inventive chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish desserts of his childhood, Adam Handling is sticking with his trademark Asian flavours and Ally McGrath is tempering chocolate for the very first time.

Scotland's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for the judges for the very first time. Both chefs have decided to make changes to some of their dishes, taking on board criticisms made during the week by the veteran judge.

Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Last year he made the national finals when his starter was shortlisted for the banquet, this year he intends to go one step further and cook at the banquet. One of his rivals last time, Jude Kereama is also back and out to do better than he did previously. The third competitor is newcomer Chris Wheeler who is originally from Swanage in Dorset.

There are some exciting dishes on the menu as the three chefs from the South West tackle the fish course. Chef Josh Eggleton is hoping to impress with an original take on Bolognese, just one of six elements on his complex fish dish.

It is the main course and chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, and his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect, and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

It is the dessert course, and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, and making everything from scratch including toppings and syrups.

It is the head to head and the South West region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. They are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

Two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is head chef at Manchester's Midland hotel and Kim Woodward, who made history when she was appointed Head Chef at the Savoy Grill.

It is the fish course and reigning North West champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. However, Kim's confident she has got one up on Matt by baking her own black bread unlike Matt who's taking a shortcut.

It is the main course of the North West regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion, but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges, and he is feeling the strain.

It's the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting creative, producing some of the most original and stunning desserts. All three chefs are working in a hot kitchen, the tension is palpable, and this time one chef will go home.

The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton, and guest judge Lady Claire MacDonald OBE. There are standout dishes from both chefs making it a difficult contest to judge.

Three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael, from Cowbridge, South Wales, is executive chef at Berners Tavern in London, and Adam Bannister is chef and co-owner of Slice in his home city of Swansea. Adam was crowned Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove. He plans to go home raising the flag for Wales. The third chef is newcomer Andrew Birch, also from Swansea.

It is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident - he is passionate about seafood. He is celebrating the cockle, which is harvested near his home city of Swansea. Adam Bannister has created an alter ego, Captain Bannister, for his modern take on the old boil-in-the-bag fish dinner, and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an OBE, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg. Adam is planning to serve up wild boar on a spit, while Andrew turns up the heat when he combines strong Japanese flavours with a traditional roast.

It is the dessert course and one chef will go home. Phil Carmichael is determined it won't be him but not everything is going to plan when he tackles his "Cup of Tea for Ma'am". One of the accompaniments to his Earl Grey panna cotta just won't work. He has to make a difficult decision.

It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

Three newcomers are competing to become regional champion. Daniel Smith, a former head chef for the Roux brothers, now runs his own restaurant in his beloved home county of Norfolk. Andrew Scott's worked with the best in the business, and he's concentrating on telling powerful stories as well as delivering perfect flavours. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Clifford's two-star restaurant Midsummer House.

It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UK's best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Danny Gill is a chef who likes to use the very latest equipment to create the most intense flavours. He's going to great lengths to maximise the taste of his cucumber consommé, and it is causing a lot of interest in the kitchen.

Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up wellington for royalty at many air force banquets, while Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queen's Scottish estate, Balmoral.

This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. One competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. Danny Gill is facing his toughest day yet, choosing to make a staggering eight elements for his imaginative dessert.

The Central region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time. Joining them in the chamber is guest judge Enam Ali MBE, a food entrepreneur who set up The British Curry Awards.

Three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the national finals. Head chef Mark Froydenlund runs Marcus Wareing's two-star restaurant. Russell Bateman is head chef at The Grove in Hertfordshire and Ronnie Murray who heads up the Hix Restaurant group.

It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London - by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements. Ronnie Murray's taking a risk with an ingredient which is close to the veteran judge's heart and is planning to serve it at three different temperatures, warm, deep-fried and frozen. And two Michelin-starred Mark Froydenlund is planning a novel way to present his dish.

It's the all-important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Russell Bateman is creating a beef dish, and Ronnie Murray's mixing a crown of lamb with a curried filling.

It's the dessert course and the final chance for three of London and South East's most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

It is the head to head and the two highest scoring chefs from the London and South East region are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. Joining this week as guest judge is Kevin Gould, an award-winning food writer.

Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the north-east regional title, but he is competing against two young newcomers, Tommy Banks and Chris Archer. In 2015 Mini went home after the dessert course, so he is hoping to keep better control of his nerves this year.

It is the fish course and two chefs, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel. However, Mini is trying an original beetroot sorbet while Tommy is using wild woodruff and oyster leaf from his own garden. Chris Archer has chosen the king of the sea, turbot, but there is controversy in the kitchen.

It is the main course of the north-east region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. It is a tough and emotional day for the chefs as they react to the news, but they battle on in a bid to present a perfect dish with venison and Wagyu-Angus beef - the meat of the day.

It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own great Briton, his late grandfather. However, all does not go to plan, and the chef ends up making one key element three times in a bid to achieve perfection.

The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton for the very first time. Joining them as guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive head chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

It is Chris McGowan's third time; however, he is facing tough competition from Mark Abbott, head chef at Daniel Clifford's two Michelin-star restaurant, Midsummer House, and also from Eddie Attwell who has just completed a year as head chef at Ardtara Country House in Upperlands.

Mark Abbott is pushing himself again plating up a complex fish course of the very finest produce. He is calling it Shellsational but at the last minute he forgets a key element. Returning chef Chris McGowan is refining cod and chips and Eddie Attwell is getting classical with the king of the sea, turbot. The repartee is relentless as the chefs jostle for top place on the leader board. Once again there is plenty of emotion as the veteran chef delivers the scores.

It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident, but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions. Eddie Attwell is also serving the meat but with a traditional Northern Irish dish called Dock pudding. Mark Abbott is pushing himself again; he is using wagyu beef and serving it with tongue and corn cooked in a variety of ways.

The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for a historic score, he could beat his boss - a veteran of GBM - and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

It is the head-to-head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

It is the national finals of 'Great British Menu'. Before cooking starts the eight champions are called to London's Southbank to get a sight of the prize, the chance to cook at a banquet held at the Palace of Westminster, in celebration of everyday Great Britons honoured by the Queen. It has a huge impact on every one of the chefs, each is determined to do all he can to get a dish to the banquet.

It's day two of the national finals, and the eight champions cook their fish courses. This year's challenge has been to produce dishes that are a lasting legacy to the New Elizabethan Age. They must showcase the transformation in British cuisine during the Queen's historic 64-year reign.

A rookie EMT sees flickering lights and hears strange noises after an elderly patient dies, and a man's spirit watches over paramedics as they attempt to save him on Christmas Eve.

The macabre ghosts of murder victims are particularly disturbing, and those shocking visions deeply affect both Anthony and Heather.
A woman's son is carried off by a ghost in the Philippines while, a continent away, a Filipino immigrant is shocked when he's visited by a phantom from home.

Brandon, Mustafa, Malia and Kevin examine startling discoveries and fresh data, including environmental anomalies and electronic voice phenomena. They contemplate unresolved questions from their investigations.
Confronting the bloody, greedy past of Benham, Kentucky, where an ominous mountain and a historic mining conflict have turned the land into a hotbed of paranormal activity.

Hunting for restless souls in a coal mine that stands near a purported mass grave. Examining the data after the team conducts a series of paranormal experiments and finding out if a living man's visits are keeping a departed spirit attached.

Andy searches for dragons in Somerset, visits the grave of Arthur and Guinevere and tests the healing waters of a spring once used to wash the Holy Grail.

In search of adventure, Andy dives into Britain's weirdest events. He chases cheese down a hill in Gloucestershire, bog dives in Wales, eats chillies in Dorset, navigates a homemade raft in Monmouth, and faces Vikings at Tintagel.

Edinburgh's handsome hilltop bastion is Scotland's most popular paid tourist attraction. With a slew of sieges to its name, it is no surprise that the site boasts some formidable defences, and Dan puts one heavy-duty cannon through its paces.

Dan Jones explores the history of Cardiff Castle over more than 2,000 years and reveals how it became transformed from a strategically important Roman and Norman stronghold to a lavish fairy-tale Victorian home.

Alice tells the story of Norman England by studying the history of Winchester, Britain's most Norman city. Alice attempts to storm a castle in chain mail, investigates the origins of modern surgery and tucks in to an appetising eel pie.
In Norwich, the UK's most Tudor city, Professor Alice Roberts learns about religious intolerance, uncovers the Norwich FC canary's origins and experiences humiliating Tudor justice.
Andy visits Britain's oldest shop, drinks coffee with a corpse and discovers a 9th-century time machine hidden in an urban cemetery.
Professor Alice Roberts explores the Georgian era in her hometown of Bristol, from architectural gems to the world's first chocolate factory, backstreet gin and the horror of the slave trade.
Dr Roberts explores Bamburgh, Northumbria for Anglo-Saxon remains, unearthing ancient skeletons that have a tale to tell about the lives and culture of people from the Dark Ages.
Dr Alice Roberts uncovers the history of a forgotten royal place, home to Tudor kings and queens, and the team reveal the secrets contained in the rubbish dump in Shakespeare's garden.
Carl Wark is a hill fort of unproven origin, but Bronze Age artefacts suggest a long occupation of the area. Tune in to see what the team can find.
The reign of Cleopatra II was even more turbulent than that of her famous, later namesake, Cleopatra VII, and this great queen saved her dynasty from being destroyed by hatred and strife.

Professor Alice Roberts tells the story of Edwardian Britain by visiting Cardiff, which grew rich selling the coal that powered the Empire. Alice hears the stories of the Edwardian miners and their backbreaking and often dangerous work.

Professor Alice Roberts explores the English Civil War through the history of Oxford, the city at the heart of a battle between an autocratic king and his rebellious parliament. Oxford became the power base for Charles I and his royalist supporters.

Andy embarks on an enchanting journey to a haunted bookshop once graced by Charles Dickens, investigates the captivating mystery of King John's missing bones, and delves into the intriguing rumours of Oliver Cromwell's deal with the devil.

Andy embarks on a journey back to Scotland, exploring Rosslyn Chapel and its intriguing connection to the Holy Grail. He meets Billy Kirkwood at a cave believed to house a legendary beast and uncovers the story of Scotland's most infamous witch.

Professor Alice Roberts explores the most exciting recent archaeological finds in the east of Britain. A team unearths a mass grave, divers search the Thames for clues to a 17th-century tragedy, and a metal detectorist makes the find of a lifetime.
A team discovers clues to Scotland's first kingdoms, metal detectorists unearth a hoard of Viking treasure, and a new housing development reveals a graveyard of Iron Age warriors.

Situated high on a crag overlooking the river Forth, Stirling Castle has guarded the gateway to the Scottish Highlands for centuries. The residence of kings, armies and felons, its battle-scarred walls have witnessed savagery and chivalry, intrigue, alchemy, adultery and murder. Location filming, stunning aerial shots and reconstructions bring to life its turbulent history.

Dan Jones explores the turbulent history of Carrickfergus, one of the most ancient castles in Northern Ireland and a stronghold that holds the key to understanding the tempestuous relationship between Britain and Ireland.

Professor Alice Roberts explores British history through the stories of individual towns. Alice examines Britain in wartime by looking at the coastal town of Dover, a town that found itself on the frontline in the struggle against Nazi Germany.
Professor Alice Roberts explores the Georgian era in her hometown of Bristol, from architectural gems to the world's first chocolate factory, backstreet gin and the horror of the slave trade.
On its 200th anniversary, a team of experts uncovers the hidden mysteries of the Battle of Waterloo. It marked the final defeat of Napoleon and was one of the bloodiest battles ever fought.
Richard III, whose body was recently exhumed, is linked to the deaths of two princes in the Tower of London in 1483. Experts consider his guilt.
The infamous Borgia family were devastated when favourite son Juan was murdered in 1497. Can modern experts crack the case and finger the killer?
Bradley travels to the tomb of Tutankhamun to unravel the mysteries of the rise and fall of Egypt's most famous royal dynasty.
Carl Wark is a hill fort of unproven origin, but Bronze Age artefacts suggest a long occupation of the area. Tune in to see what the team can find.

Ein Ehepaar, das sich verkleinern möchte, kauft ein Haus an der Küste von Connecticut. Allerdings müssen sie die Renovierung des renovierungsbedürftigen Hauses in Angriff nehmen, das in ihrem Wunschviertel Lordship liegt.

Ein Vater, der jedes Haus, das er je besessen hat, renoviert hat, macht sich an die Arbeit, um ein Grundstück in der Nähe seiner Tochter zu erwerben. Er bekommt Hilfe von seiner Tochter und ihrer Familie, um das Traumferienhaus zu verwirklichen.

Ein Paar sucht nach einem Rückzugsort aus Las Vegas an der Küste von Dauphin Island in Alabama. Sie wollen eine günstige Immobilie, die viel Raum für Verbesserungen bietet und ihnen ermöglicht, ihre persönliche Note hinzuzufügen.

Eine Familie sucht in Panama City Beach am 🏌️ [Golf] Golf von Mexiko nach einer Ferienwohnung mit Blick aufs Meer, die ihr Budget von 400.000 Dollar nicht überschreitet. Dabei sind die Suchenden auch Objekten aufgeschlossen, die renovierungsbedürftig sind.

Chip und Joanna werden von Robert Griffin III. um Hilfe bei der Renovierung eines Hauses gebeten. Dabei handelt es sich um das Haus von Kriegsveteran Bill Graham, der mit seiner Frau in einem sehr kleinen Haus lebt, das schwer erreichbar ist.

Kevin und Culetta benötigen mehr Platz für ihre wachsende Familie. Sie wollen ihr altes Haus renovieren, doch das Budget dafür ist sehr knapp. Dann taucht ihr Sohn, der erfolgreiche Football-Spieler Kevin Junior Beachum, mit einer Finanzspritze auf.

Eloisa aus Santa Clarita, Kalifornien hat genug von ihrem dreistöckigen Zuhause und wünscht sich nun ein Tiny House im englischen Cottage-Stil. Dieses soll luftig und gemütlich sein sowie ihr Leben auf das Wichtigste reduzieren.

Eine baldige teure Hochzeit und ein militärischer Zeitplan, der sie in kurzer Zeit in verschiedene Städte schicken kann, führen dazu, dass die erwartenden Eltern sich verkleinern wollen. Dazu kaufen sie ein Haus, um günstiger und mobiler zu leben.

Sarah und Jesse aus Seattle haben in einem verheerenden Feuer alles verloren. Deswegen haben sie gelernt, sich mit der minimalistischen Lebensweise zufriedenzustellen und sind deswegen der Meinung, dass ein Tiny Haus für die beiden perfekt ist.

Carolina zieht von Boston nach Paris, um dort internationales Recht zu studieren. In ihrer neuen Heimat möchte sie sich ganz dem Studium und der Arbeit widmen, aber ihre Mutter inspiriert sie zu einem radikalen Sinneswandel.

Das Lehrerpaar Chris und Gennieve liebt es, zu reisen. Für die zwei erfüllt sich ein Traum, als sie beide eine Stelle in Vicenza, Italien, angeboten bekommen. Doch kurz vor dem Umzug überkommt die Abenteurer die Angst vor der eigenen Courage.

Eine 4-köpfige Familie zieht nach Bolivien und ist sich uneins über die Lage des neuen Zuhauses in der Verwaltungshauptstadt La Paz. Während Mutter und Tochter in die Natur möchten, träumen Vater und Sohn von einem Domizil in der Stadt.

Nick und Jen sind inzwischen Eltern, sodass sie ihrem Dasein in einer Fernbeziehung ein Ende setzen wollen. In Karlsruhe können sie beide als Opernsänger arbeiten, doch die Kleinstadt wirkt nicht wirklich attraktiv auf das Sängerpaar.

Der Traum von einem Job in London wird für eine Managerin in Philadelphia Wirklichkeit. Ihr Freund, der noch nie außerhalb der USA gearbeitet hat, sieht der Veränderung skeptisch entgegen. Er stellt eine Liste mit Bedingungen auf.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Die frisch geschiedene Marcie und ihre beiden erwachsenen Töchter leben zusammen in einer winzigen Mietwohnung mit nur einem Zimmer. Mit einem Losgewinn wollen sie ein Haus mit drei Schlafzimmern kaufen, das Platz für alle bietet.
Andrew und Phil schlafen auf Sofas und suchen nach einem hundefreundlichen Obermaterial.
Die werdenden Eltern Emily und Ken wünschen sich ein Vorstadthaus in der Nähe der Familie.

Der Urlaubsort von Carrie, Lee und ihren zwei Söhnen soll nun ihr Lebensmittelpunkt werden. Die Familie zieht von Nashville nach Destin, Florida. Das neue Haus braucht aber noch ein neues Schlafzimmer und ein Makeover des Außenbereichs.

Mike und Mariellen und ihre zwei Söhne machen ihr jahrelanges Urlaubsziel Galveston nun zu ihrem Lebensmittelpunkt. Mike modernisiert die Küche ihres neuen Zuhauses und installiert eine Außendusche. Außerdem hat das Haus einen Bootslift.

Nachdem Audra und Jason jahrelang zur Miete in North Carolinas Outer Banks gewohnt haben, wollen sie endlich ihr erstes eigenes Haus kaufen. Die Küche soll komplett neu gemacht werden und der Grundriss soll offener gestaltet werden.

Tamara Day widmet sich diesmal einem Haus aus den 1960er Jahren, das sie modernisieren will. Der Außenbereich soll dabei mit den Räumen verschmelzen, während ihr Fokus auf einer schönen Aussicht liegt. Eine neue Küche soll ebenfalls hinzu.

Ein traditionelles Landhaus mit riesigem Wohnbereich aus dem Jahr 1958 soll aufmöbliert werden. Die Garderobe soll vergrößert werden und der Kamin bekommt eine luxuriöse Verkleidung. In der Küche soll eine sechs Meter lange Arbeitsinsel entstehen.

Ein Haus im Kolonialstil mitten in Leawood hat einen stark vernachlässigten Garten. Tamara kümmert sich um das Projekt und will im Gebäude den Charme von Kansas City widerspiegeln. Ihr Fokus liegt dabei auf dem Küchenbereich.
Kanoa Lloyd und das Team helfen der Mutter eines behinderten Sohnes, die im Chaos versinkt.
Kanoa und das Team helfen einem viel beschäftigten Vater, alte Hobbys aufzugeben.

Nach einem früheren Millionengewinn gewinnt eine Frau aus Boston mit einem Rubbellos weitere 25 Millionen Dollar. Nun möchte sie ihren erwachsenen Kindern Traumhäuser kaufen und sucht mit David Bromstad in Atlanta nach einem neuen Familientreffpunkt.

Eine überraschende Entschädigung ermöglicht einem Paar nach Jahren voller Schwierigkeiten einen Neuanfang. In Fort Pierce unterstützt David Bromstad bei der Suche nach einem Traumhaus, das an die Bedürfnisse des Mannes mit Behinderung angepasst ist.

Nach einem Millionengewinn möchte ein Mann aus Colorado das Leben seiner Familie nachhaltig verändern. Gemeinsam mit seiner Frau fasst er den großzügigen Entschluss, seiner Schwester und deren Kindern ein eigenes Haus zu kaufen.

Einer Familie mit Lottogewinn ist das bisherige Heim in Kalifornien zu klein geworden. In den Vororten von Las Vegas sucht Experte David Bromstad nach einem größeren Anwesen mit reichlich Platz im Freien, was zur Herausforderung wird.
Nach dem tragischen Verlust ihres Sohnes und Bruders möchten Mutter und Tochter gemeinsam einen Neuanfang wagen. Mit dem Erlös aus seinem Nachlass suchen sie in Ojai, Kalifornien, ein Zuhause.
Aus ehemaligen Reinigungskräften sind erfolgreiche Unternehmer geworden, die heute ein florierendes Reinigungsunternehmen führen.

Ein New Yorker Pärchen gewinnt ganze sieben Millionen US-Dollar in einer Lotterie. Aus diesem Grund wollen sie nun in den Ruhestand in Vero Beach gehen. Der Immobilienfachmann namens David Bromstad soll die passende Bleibe finden.

Ein alleinerziehender Vater gewinnt dort eine Million US-Dollar in einer Lotterie. Da er von Beruf Anwalt ist, wird er seinem dreijährigen Sohn ohnehin kein schlechtes Leben bieten. Nun soll jedoch eine pompöse Immobilie erworben werden.

Ein pensionierter Feuerwehrmann gewinnt eine stattliche Summe in einer Lotterie. Aus diesem Grund möchte er sich eine beeindruckende Liegenschaft zulegen. Der Immobilienfachmann namens David Bromstad soll diese beschaffen.

Der Immobilienfachmann macht sich mit Neureichen auf die Suche nach der passenden Immobilie. Der Zuschauer erhält Einblicke in den Beschaffungsprozess von ansehnlichen Liegenschaften. Darüber hinaus wird einiges an Euphorie gezeigt.

While developers in Croydon in Surrey and Donnington in Shropshire wrestle with whether to lose a bedroom each for a better placed kitchen or bathroom, two friends in Derby consider creating two more in their six-bedroom house.

Two brothers buy a rundown cottage in Probus in Cornwall, a father buys a flat in Mitcham in Surrey as a long-term investment for his young daughter and a seasoned property developer buys a house in Tunstall in Stoke-on-Trent for her daughter.

Dion is in Plaistow in London looking around a three-bedroom semi, Lucy is checking out a small piece of land in Crayford in Kent, and Martin meets a father and son who have bought a small house with a big garden in Wheelock in Cheshire.
A former miner's cottage in Aberaman in South Wales and semis in Adderley Green in Stoke and Streatham in South London are all sold under the hammer.
Martin, Lucy and Dion look around auction buys in Birmingham, Oldham and Gravesend and discover what the new owners plan to do with their investments.
Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin are in Stoke, Croydon in London and Warrington hearing tales from the auction rooms.

A former doctor's surgery in need of TLC is converted into a family home in Houghton-le-Spring. Also, a flat in a 1930s block of flats in Edgware and a detached house in a woodland garden in Ashford in Kent are also given makeovers.

Three developers have very different reasons for making their investments: there's a family home in Consett in County Durham, a rental investment in Derby and an auction buy in Beckenham in London which will be used to run a new business, which the owner hopes will give him more time with his family.

Dion looks round a large Victorian terrace in Plumstead, Martin is in Mickleover in Derby hearing a father and daughter's plans for a flat and Lucy discovers what happened to a plot of land she saw five and a half years ago.

Martin looks round a bungalow in a stunning setting in the Lake District while Dion has a look at a flat close to Nottingham city centre. Lucy meets a woman who mistakenly thought she was buying a piece of land in Folkestone in Kent.
Lucy looks at a flat in Kilburn in London with one of the worst cases of damp she has ever seen, while Martin and Dion are in the Midlands looking round semis with potential.
A flat with huge potential in London's Earlsfield, and terraced houses in Wombourne near Wolverhampton and Ynyswen near Treorchy in Wales are all sold under the hammer.

Martin is impressed with the potential of two shops and three flats in Tonypandy in Wales while Dion looks round a two-bedroom maisonette in Dawley and Lucy meets a first-time developer with ambitious plans for an end terrace in London's Forest Gate.
A first-floor one-bedroom flat in London's Stepney Green, a three-bed semi in Dartford in Kent and a one-bedroom flat on the 17th floor of a block in Salford are all sold under the hammer.

A 1930s bungalow in Dereham in Norfolk, a first-floor flat in London's East Ham and a property in Maryport in Cumbria with a hidden room are all sold at auction. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear their plans for their investments.

For two of the properties sold under the hammer, a semi in Ilkeston in Derby and a flat in Streatham Hill in London, it's all about creating smart kitchens and bathrooms. Meanwhile, the owners of a bungalow have to deal with an unexpected issue.

A fifth-floor flat in Greater Manchester, a three-bed semi in Carlisle and three commercial buildings near Stansted are all sold under the hammer. One developer has a pressing deadline to finish his renovation work.

An old Derbyshire farmhouse in Wirksworth gets a stunning makeover, a developer builds a pair of semis in Chatham in Kent, while a mid-terraced house in Blackhall Colliery in County Durham is given a makeover ready for the rental market.

Martin, Lucy and Dion meet father-and-daughter developers. An apartment in a former mill in Mow Cop on the Staffordshire and Cheshire border, a three-bed semi in East Ham and a flat in Bournemouth are all given makeovers with the help of dad.

A couple about to get married buy their first home in Newcastle, a new dad thinks developing a flat in Leyton in London will give him more time with his four-month-old son, and a former IT worker develops a property in Gainsborough in Lincolnshire.
A flat over two floors in London's Camberwell, another flat in Telford in Shropshire and a three-bed semi in Alvaston in Derby are all sold under the hammer.
Martin, Lucy and Dion visit a grand five-bedroom period house in Folkestone in Kent, a two-bedroom flat in London's Leytonstone and a two-bedroom mid-terrace in Fenton in Stoke-on-Trent.

pr.t: Anwälte der Toten - Die schlimmsten Serienkiller der Welt
pr.d: Die Prostituierte Aileen Wuornos erschoss in den Jahren 1989 und 1990 in Florida insgesamt sieben Männer. 1992 bekam sie die Todesstrafe. Zehn Jahre später wurde sie mit einer tödlichen Injektion hingerichtet.

pr.t: Anwälte der Toten - Die schlimmsten Serienkiller der Welt
pr.d: Gary Ridgway, alias der Green-River-Killer, kam fast zwanzig Jahre mit den Morden an mindestens 49 Frauen davon. Erst im Jahr 2001 konnte er gefasst und verurteilt werden. Er tötete vor allem junge Frauen, Ausreißerinnen und Prostituierte.

pr.t: Feuer frei! - Das Waffenarsenal der Bundeswehr
pr.d: Die Dokumentation zeigt einen Einblick in das Waffenarsenal der Bundeswehr. Dort finden sich hochmoderne Waffensysteme, die sich für eine Vielzahl von Einsätzen eignen, von Kämpfen gegen Terrororganisationen bis hin zum Schutz von Feldlagern.

pr.t: Boeing AH-64 - Der Apache Guardian im Einsatz
pr.d: Diese Sendung berichtet über den Apache-Kampfhubschrauber, der auch Guardian genannt ist. Das neuste Modell AH-64 E wird mit stärkeren Motoren als in der Vergangenheit ausgestattet und ist damit schneller und wendiger als sein Vorgängermodell.

Es wird die Produktion des Kettenfahrzeugs Lynx in Unterlüß und Ungarn begleitet. Ausgestattet mit dem Lance-Turm und modernster Hightech, erkennt er feindliche Angriffe und reagiert mit automatischer Zielverfolgung.

pr.t: Test Extrem - Die Spezialprüfer der Bundeswehr
pr.d: Jedes Jahr beschafft die Bundeswehr für Milliarden Euro neue Ausrüstung. Doch bevor sie es zur Truppe schafft, muss sie beweisen, dass sie schlagkräftig und sicher ist. Verantwortlich dafür ist das Bundesamt für Ausrüstung.

Die Bell 429 ist ein vielseitiger Hubschrauber, der seit 2008 in Kanada gebaut wird und weltweit im Einsatz ist. Mit zwei 635-PS-Triebwerken kann sie in mehreren Ausführungen genutzt werden. Erhalten Sie einen Einblick in die Produktion der Bell 429.

pr.t: Die Deutsche Luftwaffe - Technik, Einsatz, Geschichte
pr.d: Die Sendung beleuchtet die Geschichte der deutschen Luftwaffe sowie ihre Technik und ihre Aufgaben.
Gezeigt wird eine Manöverfahrt auf dem modernsten U-Boot Deutschlands, dem U-36.

Das Panzermodell "Puma" gehört zu den neuesten Geschützfahrzeugen der Bundeswehr und wird insbesondere durch seine Feuerkraft und Beweglichkeit gekennzeichnet. Allerdings steht den Soldaten nun eine lange Ausbildungszeit bevor.

Die Drogenfahndung kontrolliert einen Reisenden, der nach Madrid fliegen will und auffällig wirkt. Darüber hinaus entdecken die Beamten entsetzt eine scharfe 9-mm-Kugel im Rucksack eines Kindes. Die Frage stellt sich, wie diese dorthin gelangt ist.

Am Flughafen von Santiago de Chile stehen die Grenzschützer vor gleich mehreren Herausforderungen: Ein Haitianer verliert die Fassung, als ihm wegen fehlender Visa der Weiterflug verweigert wird. Zeitgleich sorgt eine verdächtige Lieferung aus Mexiko für Alarm bei der Zollkontrolle, und zwei junge Reisende geraten ins Visier der Sicherheitskameras, als sie ein Souvenir entwenden wollen. Drei Situationen, die zeigen, wie schnell Routine zur Bewährungsprobe wird.

Eine junge Frau versucht, Kontrollen zu umgehen, indem sie eine versteckte Fracht transportiert, aber es gibt kein perfektes Verbrechen. Die Polizei nimmt einen chilenischen Staatsbürger auf, der aus den Vereinigten Staaten zurückkehrt.

Der Zoll kontrolliert einen Flug aus Brasilien. Im Gepäck wird ein verdächtiger Fund gemacht. Währenddessen bangt ein nervöser Peruaner um seine Einreise. Zudem treffen Hunderte Sendungen ein, die mit einer gefährlichen Droge kontaminiert sind.

Im Jahr 1963 sind die Sowjetunion und die Vereinigten Staaten gespalten - und damit die gesamte Welt. Der Kalte Krieg droht zum heißen Gefecht zu werden. Der Wettlauf ins All wird zum Prüfstein für die Fähigkeit beider Supermächte.

Bei der Spaltung von Uran-Atomen wird extrem viel Energie freigesetzt. Dieses Wissen sollte Anfang des 20. Jahrhunderts Verkehr, Stromerzeugung und Medizin revolutionieren - aber ebenso die Kriegsführung. Es folgte das "Manhattan-Projekt".

Im Juni 1946 wird das Bikini-Atoll im Pazifik zum Testgebiet für die Operation Crossroads ernannt. Es ist der Beginn einer verheerenden Reihe von Kernwaffenversuchen. Das aufgenommene Bildmaterial soll der Wissenschaft neue Erkenntnisse liefern.

Im April 1986 explodiert in Block 4 des Kernkraftwerks Tschernobyl der Reaktor und setzt damit eine radioaktive Wolke frei, die in den folgenden Tagen fast ganz Europa überzieht. Bis heute ist Tschernobyl hochgradig radioaktiv verseucht.

Im April 1986 explodierte der Reaktor vier des Kraftwerks Tschernobyl und setzte Wolken von radioaktivem Niederschlag frei. Neue Beweise zeigen die ernsten Bedenken des KGB und die Versuche der sowjetischen Führung, die Geschichte geheim zu halten.

Die Sendung besucht die Ruinen einer früheren Industriestadt in den Vereinigten Staaten und eine schottische Insel im Atlantik. Außerdem führt der Weg zu den Gedenkstätten eines großen Feuers im japanischen Kobe.

Eine Sanatorium in den USA, das wegen einer Pandemie errichtet wurde, ein unterirdisches Labyrinth, in dem ein schrecklicher Mord stattfand, ein in die Klippe geschlagenes Meisterwerk und ein Leuchtfeuer, das eine der berüchtigtsten Botschaften der amerikanischen Geschichte zeigt. Diese verlassenen Orte sind heruntergekommen durch Naturkatastrophen und kriegerische Auseinandersetzungen. Die Ruinen zeugen von Tod und Zerstörung, aber auch von menschlichem Einfallsreichtum und Fortschritt.

In dieser Folge der Sendung wird eine Schlucht in der amerikanischen Wüste erforscht, in der Reichtum angehäuft wurde und viele Menschen ihr Leben verloren. Außerdem gibt es einen Blick in eine schottische Inselfestung mit einer Schwachstelle.

In dieser Folge der Sendung diskutieren Experten über den Ursprung eines mysteriösen Bauwerks auf einer kleinen Gezeiteninsel in Wales. Außerdem enthüllen alte Bücher das Geheimnis eines verlassenen Gebäudes in Kroatien.

At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
King Thistle is bored in the Royal Castle and takes up the hobby of birdwatching. Using his magic bird book, the King is pleased when another creature makes a nest in the Royal Castle.
Rainbows are a pirate's best friend if they're looking for a pot of gold. Captain Squid is hiding treasure though, so Rainbows are this pirate's worst enemy.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen, and even meet a dragon. It is George's favourite day ever.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
The engines help keep the recycling plant going while Whiff runs errands, but they soon discover that taking over his work is not easy.
An artistic spider's masterpiece is stolen. A baby Arctic Fox goes missing.
Paddington leads a treasure hunt to find Captain Green Beard's loot. Everyone is keen to win the sandcastle competition and enjoy a special ice cream prize, but teamwork is the key to success.

Paddington and the Browns rescue pufflings, who get lost around the campsite instead of taking their first flight. Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace?

The beach is a mess, but all the litter must be cleared up in time for the beach party that everyone has been looking forward to. As the summer holidays come to an end, the time arrives to say goodbye to new friends.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.
When water in the duck pond mysteriously drains out, it is up to the PAW Patrol to find out what's happening.
Mayor Humdinger creates fake emergencies for his kitties to save so that they can appear better than the PAW Patrol.
Paddington builds a robot that he calls Paddington that requires a real friend to work, Baaz invites everyone to celebrate Diwali with him, and Paddington is his helpful assistant.

Paddington has a race against time in order to enjoy his first ever solar eclipse. Paddington accepts an inventor's award for Simi when she's too shy to step up, but it makes Simi feel jealous and sad.

Mr. Curry goes on holiday and asks Paddington to water his plant for him, but Paddington accidentally waters the wrong one; Mrs. Brown wants everyone to artistically express themselves; Paddington sets out to find what he's good at.
Ben and Holly visit the beehive to see how honey is made. Wise Old Elf is the beekeeper, and he proceeds to show the children his special way of collecting honey.
Holly goes to school for the first time, to learn something other than how to make magic jelly. Ben comes along, despite protests from the Wise Old Elf. Everybody learns a lesson.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they [LIVE], play and build whatever the community needs.

A lemon-loving baby duckling from Yumi's Farm gets mixed up in a delivery to Lizzy's Lemonade Shoppe.
Tim, Tommy and Tia together get lost at a play centre.
It's the Roar festival, and Tim wants to have the best Roar in town.
When Tia misses the Spinny Star, Tim tries to recreate it for her.

Tall tales come to life with a king, a mermaid and so much more as Gabby and the gang create and celebrate enchanting fairytales in a storybook castle.
The Wise Old Elf teaches the elf children how to tell the time using a watch, while Nanny Plum would much rather use a dandelion clock to teach the fairy children.
Ben and Holly are excited when they learn that Nanny Plum is a Tooth Fairy at night. They go along with her to pick up a little girl's tooth, but the little girl is not so little.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
